run_multiprocess_evaluation: run multi-GPU semantic segmentation evaluation on a validation dataset using argparse CLI
evaluate_segmentation_module: evaluate a segmentation module on a data loader and send accuracy results to a queue
visualize_segmentation_result: visualize segmentation predictions by concatenating original image, ground truth, and predicted masks
worker_gpu_process: spawn a worker process on a specific GPU to evaluate a subset of validation images
main_evaluation_orchestration: orchestrate multi-process evaluation across GPUs and print per-class IoU and mean accuracy summary
